title: The Alt-Right Playbook: I Hate Mondays
summary: An Innuendo Studios Alt-Right Playbook episode about a rhetorical tactic of dismissing partial fixes to problems. It frames this as a style of argument that treats flaws as unfixable facts of life.
why: Referenced to describe an argument style that rejects incremental improvements, and in discussions of differing liberal and conservative views of society.

quote.text: There's an interesting video essay on this exact style of argument, if you're interested.
